features.title: A Blessed & Dedicated Learning Journey
features.subtitle: Crafted with patience and excellence to instill the love of Quran in your heart and home from the comfort of your schedule.
features.f1Desc: Individual attention where the teacher focuses entirely on your pace, tajweed, and understanding without distractions.

courses.title: Islamic & Quranic Courses Offered
courses.subtitle: From foundation phonetics to full memorization and daily Sunnah supplications for the entire family.
courses.c1Desc: The essential starting point for beginners of all ages to master Arabic alphabets, correct sound articulation (Makharij), and joint letters.
courses.c2Desc: Reading the Holy Quran with correct flow, proper pauses (Waqf), rhythmic fluency, and utmost reverence.
courses.c3Desc: A structured, step-by-step memorization plan with daily revision (Sabaq, Sabqi, Manzil) under experienced Hafiz guidance.
courses.c4Desc: Detailed study and practice of Ghunnah, Ikhfa, Idgham, Qalqalah, and letter attributes to recite exactly as revealed.
courses.c5Desc: Understanding the meanings, moral lessons, historical context, and divine wisdom of the verses for real-life application.
courses.c6Desc: Step-by-step practical training of Wudu, Fardh & Sunnah raka'ats, Tashahhud, Dua-e-Qunoot, and Salah errors to avoid.
courses.c7Desc: Essential daily morning/evening supplications, eating, sleeping, entering mosque, travel prayers, and 40 Rabbana Duas.

aboutTeacher.title: Maulana Qari Mohammad Fakir
aboutTeacher.bioP1: Maulana Qari Mohammad Fakir is an accomplished Islamic scholar and certified Qari with more than 8 years of rigorous experience teaching Quran to overseas students of all ages — children, youth, women, men, and elders — across the UK, USA, Canada, and Europe.
aboutTeacher.bioP2: He is renowned for his patient, gentle, and respectful demeanor that makes students of all age groups feel motivated and confident. His mastery over Tajweed rules, coupled with modern interactive teaching pedagogy over Zoom, ensures steady and enjoyable progress.
aboutTeacher.bioP3: Beyond recitation, Maulana Qari Mohammad Fakir instills Islamic manners (Adab), Sunnah habits, and genuine love for Allah's words in every student.
highlights: Certified Hafiz-ul-Quran & Qari with authentic Sanad
Specialized in mentoring non-Arabic speaking overseas students (Kids & Adults)
Bilingual instruction with smooth communication for families

testimonials.title: Trusted by Muslim Families Overseas
testimonials.subtitle: Real feedback from overseas families across the UK, USA, and Canada who trusted us with their Quranic education.
testimonials.t1Quote: Finding a reliable, punctual, and patient Quran teacher in London was tough with busy school hours. Maulana Qari Fakir has been phenomenal! Both my son and daughter finished Noorani Qaida with perfect Makharij and now love their daily lessons.
testimonials.t2Quote: The time zone flexibility for the USA is incredible. The Zoom setup is professional, and the one-on-one attention keeps our family lessons completely focused. We are so grateful for the 3-day free trial that convinced us immediately.
testimonials.t3Quote: Maulana Qari Mohammad Fakir not only teaches fluent recitation but also teaches Namaz and daily Masnoon Duas with practical demonstrations. The patience he shows is extraordinary. Highly recommended for all overseas families!
